newsitem.title: USA: Provident Bancorp to merge with Fla. bank.
newsitem.headline: Provident Bancorp to merge with Fla. bank.

text.p: Provident Bancorp Inc said Monday it has definitively agreed to acquire South Hillsborough Community Bank, a $40 million Florida state chartered bank.
South Hillsborough shareholders will receive Provident common shares with aggregate value of $7,151,900 in the merger, Provident said.

The deal requires South Hillsborough shareholder shareholder approval and is expected to close in late 1996 or early 1997, Provident said. Hillsborough would become a subsidiary of Provident, a $6.4 billion, Cincinnati-based bank holding company.
